description: Agent Tax Records: submit a filed return with the books it answers to: the return with its reference, form, tax period, the last day of the period, the filing deadline the record states, the day filed, whether it is original or amended and the original an amended return amends, its currency, each filed line with its id, the line or label, the amount filed and the ledger account it is drawn from, the schedules the return names and the schedules the record holds; the ledger or trial balance with its reference, the day it is as of and each figure with its account and amount; optionally the draft return with each draft line, its amount and any note on a change, and the original returns the record holds. The signed report gives the filed return and the ledger, each filed line against the ledger figures for its account, each schedule the return names against the schedules held, the filing date against the deadline, an amended return against its original and each draft figure against the filed copy, and counts them, and names a divergent filed return: a filed line that does not tie to the ledger figures, a schedule named in the return and missing from the record, a return filed after the deadline the record states, an amended return with no original beneath it, and a figure changed between the draft and the filed copy with no note; then a filed line given twice and a ledger dated apart from the tax period, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No filed lines, no ledger figures, a line naming no ledger account or one the ledger does not hold, schedules named with no record of those held, or no deadline or filing date leaves those points unverified. Ledger accounts match by their number or their words, the figures for one account add together, lines and schedules match by their letters and digits or their words, amounts compare to the cent and dates by the day. This reads whether the filed return ties to the books it was drawn from, line by line. Verdict tax_filing_divergent, tax_filing_partial, tax_filing_unverified or tax_filing_consistent. POST /api/tax-filing-check. Reads the tax records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it gives no tax advice, prepares or files nothing and decides nothing about anyone’s tax liability, which stay with the taxpayer and their tax professional, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Tax Records reads tax records: a filed return, tax payment records, sales tax records, withholding records, information returns, estimated payment records, deduction claims and tax authority notices, each against the books, schedules and deadline, the amounts the filed returns state as due, the stated rate and the sales tax remittances, the payroll record and the withholding remittances, the payment records, the periods and amounts the stated method sets, the support records, or the filed returns and responses it answers to. The family’s ground is the tax record set itself; the Agent Bookkeeping family reads the books the filings are drawn from, and this family reads the filings, payments and notices after they exist. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-tax-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-tax-records/.
